title: A weekend stroll through Taipei's Chifeng Street: award-winning pour-over and caramel pudding hidden in an old courtyard house
subtitle: Wandering through memories of blacksmiths and machinery, searching for a quiet coffee glow that belongs to today's Taipei
author: HiMyDream Editorial · Ivy
content:
On a weekend afternoon, as sunlight slants through the narrow lanes between Shuanglian and Zhongshan MRT stations and the faint scent of metal machinery still lingers, Chifeng Street has quietly slipped into an artsy new skin. Once Taipei's most famous 'blacksmith street', it is now the loveliest home to independent bookshops, antique shops, and artisanal cafés.

Push open the wooden door and the sweet aroma of dark-roasted coffee beans and freshly baked cinnamon rolls rushes out. The old house's courtyard still keeps its half-century-old terrazzo floor and green plants, and a small patch of blue sky peeks overhead. Order a sun-dried Yirgacheffe pour-over from Ethiopia—bright peach acidity blooming on the tongue—paired with a bittersweet caramel baked pudding whose silky egg custard and deep, grown-up caramel instantly wash away the week's tension. On Chifeng Street, time seems to slow, inviting travelers to savor every sweet moment.

spotInfo.name: Chifeng Heritage House Picks · Fuguang Books & Courtyard Coffee Salon
spotInfo.address: 2F, No. 16, Lane 47, Chifeng Street, Datong District, Taipei
spotInfo.signature: Specialty Yirgacheffe pour-over, grown-up caramel pudding, handmade cinnamon roll
spotInfo.transport: A 3-minute walk from Shuanglian MRT Exit 1, or a 5-minute walk from Zhongshan MRT Exit 4

title: A hidden retreat in the Jinguashi mountain town: savoring mist-kissed pour-over coffee and sea-breeze pie at San San Bu
subtitle: Leaving Jiufen's bustling old street behind, climb the stone steps of Qitang Old Street to find a gentle, mountain-embraced old world
author: HiMyDream Editorial · Ken
content:
Most visitors to the Northeast Coast rush through Jiufen's crowds for a quick photo; but follow the Jinshui Road a little deeper to Qitang Old Street and the world suddenly falls quiet. No clusters of red lanterns or hawkers' calls—only mountain mist drifting like silk around Earless Teapot Mountain.

San San Bu stands quietly beside the rainbow stone steps. It is a Japanese-style wooden miners' dormitory the owner spent years restoring by hand. Slide open the wooden lattice door and old vinyl records fill the air with the gentle sound of a cello. Inside are just a few leather sofas and a window-side counter; outside, Jinguashi's rolling green hills unfold. The owner slowly pours water through freshly ground Kenya AA beans, releasing rich blackcurrant and berry aromas. Paired with a warm, freshly baked lemon pound cake, and with the mountain mist parting and gathering again outside the window—this is the very soul of Taiwan's Northeast Coast.

spotInfo.name: San San Bu Coffee & Hostel
spotInfo.address: No. 172, Qitang Road, Jinguashi, Ruifang District, New Taipei City
spotInfo.signature: House-roasted Kenya AA pour-over, signature lemon tart, handmade caramel apple pie
spotInfo.transport: Take Keelung Bus 1062 or 788 to Jinguashi (Gold Museum) stop, then walk 6 minutes along Qitang Old Street
spotInfo.mapQuery: No. 172, Qitang Road, Ruifang District, New Taipei City

title: A 50-year-old Tainan printing house reborn: stepping into the timber heritage aesthetic of StableNice BLDG.
subtitle: Timber, red brick, and a semi-open courtyard—old Tainan reinterprets coffee culture in its freshest design language
author: HiMyDream Editorial · You
content:
Tainan's alleyways are always full of surprises. Tucked away on Nanning Street, StableNice BLDG. was once a timber printing house that served the city for half a century. The third-generation owner, rather than erasing its history, combined the old letterpress machines, weathered red-brick facade, and warm Taiwanese timber into a vertically symbiotic arts-and-coffee space.

The first-floor bar uses a top-tier Italian espresso machine, while the pour-over menu features selections from renowned guest roasters across Taiwan. Upstairs, an open-air courtyard lets sunlight pour in, illuminating walls of local indie publications and design goods. Take a sip of the signature 'smoked longan iced americano'—the subtle sweetness of dried longan mingling with the bitterness of espresso, bursting with a familiar yet modern flavor memory. Here, you're not just drinking coffee; you're having a beautiful conversation between Tainan's old soul and modern life.

spotInfo.name: StableNice BLDG. Timber Heritage Café
spotInfo.address: No. 9, Lane 83, Nanning Street, West Central District, Tainan City
spotInfo.signature: Smoked longan iced americano, classic timber blend pour-over, half-baked cheesecake
spotInfo.transport: From Tainan Railway Station, take a bus to Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Xintiandi stop, then walk about 4 minutes
spotInfo.mapQuery: No. 9, Lane 83, Nanning Street, West Central District, Tainan City

title: Sunset over the Hongchai cliff on the Hengchun Peninsula: Yamano Cafe's 180° azure sea view and daydreams
subtitle: Sunshine, sea breeze, a big lawn, and pets at play—a stress-free lazy afternoon at Taiwan's southern tip
author: HiMyDream Editorial · Hao
content:
Leave the noise of Kenting Main Street behind and climb the winding west-coast road up the hillside behind Hongchai. What greets you is a pure, clean white—white fair-faced concrete, white parasols, and ahead, the deep blue Taiwan Strait stretching unbroken to the horizon.

Yamano Cafe commands the most captivating sunset view on the entire Hengchun Peninsula. On the broad, flat green lawn, travelers play with their dogs or sit barefoot on the wooden deck, breathing in the sea breeze. Order a refreshing iced Sicilian lemon coffee—the bright tartness of fresh lemon juice melding with a fine, silky layer of coffee foam—and the tropical heat melts away in a single sip. As the golden sun sinks slowly into the sea at 5:30, the sky turns a blend of pink-purple and golden-orange, and everyone quietly puts down their phones, lost in this irreplaceable romantic moment at Taiwan's southern tip.

spotInfo.name: Yamano Cafe (Hongchai sunset view)
spotInfo.address: No. 2-9, Hongchai Road, Hengchun Township, Pingtung County
spotInfo.signature: Sicilian iced lemon americano, Hengchun harbor tea latte, handmade sea-salt cream cheese
spotInfo.transport: Best reached by car or charter; about a 15-minute drive from Hengchun, with a large free parking lot
